summary: Register Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce open-source core) as a self-hosted storefront provider (products/inventory/prices/orders/returns) authenticated with a single long-lived Integration bearer token, reusing the existing host-injected registry boundary.

impacts.evidence: Magento accounts are tenant-scoped Connector SDK accounts identical in shape to woocommerce/medusa/shopware/opencart/prestashop; the store host is admin-supplied per-account non-secret runtime config, the same pattern every self-hosted storefront connector already uses.
The Integration access token stays behind the existing SecretAccessor/UseSecret boundary; product/order projections retain only bounded remote ids (SKU), numbers, statuses and amounts.
Magento reuses the existing generic product/price sync machinery verbatim; no new public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is added.
No EventBus schema is added or changed.

Connector SDK root Connector/Runtime remain frozen; Magento implements only existing capability-specific ports, no port is added or changed. Unlike Shopware's self-managed OAuth2 client_credentials exchange, Magento's Integration issues one long-lived access token used directly as a bearer credential -- no runtime token exchange or refresh logic is needed at all, so no OAuth runtime (ADR-0104/ADR-0108) interaction was needed or made.
No schema change; Magento uses the same generic non-secret runtime-config store every runtime_config_template connector already uses.

Fixed admin-supplied host, opaque bearer token behind SecretAccessor, bounded inputs and normalized errors preserve the provider boundary. Product create and webhook receipt return a normalized unsupported error with no faked success, since neither has a safe/verifiable implementation given what this connector's credential and the generic write contract carry.
products.write/prices.write/inventory.write/orders.status.write remain gated by the same capability checks every storefront connector already uses.
Writes flow through the existing fetch-compare-write-reconcile receipt path; no new evidence shape is introduced.

Writes follow the existing fetch-compare-write-reconcile pattern (see docs/connectors/magento/reconciliation.md); ambiguous transport failures reconcile against a re-fetch rather than retrying blindly.

Outbound authority is the admin-configured store host only, DNS-pinned through the existing SSRF-safe transport; inbound webhook receipt is explicitly unsupported in this task (see capability-audit.md), not silently unverified.
Non-2xx responses and malformed bodies are normalized to bounded errors.
Magento can be disabled by removing its connector accounts; no schema rollback is needed.

Provider tests, go build/vet/test and the Task-064 conformance candidate pass 12 of 13 checks -- sandbox_isolation could not be exercised because this execution environment cannot create unprivileged Linux user namespaces, an environment constraint shared by every connector's Task-029 probe. docs/connectors/magento/conformance-report.json records this genuine result rather than a fabricated pass.
